title: Salty Kisses - 30A Five Star Properties
description_expanded:
Welcome to Salty Kisses 🌊

Your private coastal retreat in the gated Villages of Crystal Beach, one of Destin’s most sought-after beach communities.

🌴 SALTY KISSES — RESORT AMENITIES & GUEST PERKS

⭐ Professionally managed with 24/7 guest support by 30A Five Star Properties 🏝️ 30,000 sq. ft. tropical lagoon-style pool — one of the area’s most stunning resort pools 🔥 Pool heated seasonally (March 1–April 15, Thanksgiving week, Christmas week & New Year’s week) for comfortable swimming year-round 🏖️ Beach wagon, chairs & toys included so beach days are easy and stress-free 💦 Three waterfalls, relaxing hot tub & surround-sound music create a true resort-style experience 🍹 Shaded tiki bar perfect for poolside lounging and vacation cocktails 🚎 Seasonal beach trolley service (March 1–November 1) offering convenient pick-up & drop-off to the beach 🌴 Beautifully landscaped walkways throughout a private gated community for peaceful strolls ✨ Whether you're relaxing poolside or hopping on the trolley to the beach, Salty Kisses puts coastal luxury and convenience right at your fingertips.

This custom-built coastal retreat is designed for comfort, entertaining, and unforgettable vacations.

✨ Home Highlights Two Master Suites — private retreats on both floors Custom bunk space perfect for kids Second-floor loft + additional living area Private upstairs balcony for golden-hour sunsets Modern furnishings + fresh décor throughout Chef-ready kitchen with: Expansive granite countertops Beautiful cabinetry Stainless steel appliances Designer tile backsplash With its spacious layout, the home lives like a 5-bedroom, ideal for families and groups.

🛏️ Sleeping Arrangements

FIRST FLOOR Primary Suite: King bed, private bath with soaking tub & walk-in shower (sleeps 2) Half bath off kitchen

SECOND FLOOR Guest Suite: King bed, private bath with shower (sleeps 2) Guest Bedroom: King bed, shared tub/shower combo (sleeps 2) Bunk Room: Twin-over-Full bunks (sleeps 6), shared tub/shower combo Upstairs Landing: Daybed with trundle (sleeps 2)

Top Attractions: • The Beach - 7 minute walk

• Big Kahuna's Water Park - 10 minutes

• Harborwalk Village - 12 minutes

• Baytowne Wharf - 15 minutes

• Fudpucker & Go Karts - 5 minutes

WE OFFER A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM GUEST AMENITIES Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath towels | Bed linens
